comments.body:
@pcbeingused333  Thank you for your donation; There is one lint test fail under demand processing
  
  - lint version:
  golangci-lint has version 2.9.0  

use `make lint` recheck
  
- lint error detail:
```
  Error: builder/workhub/urgent_manager_test.go:254:7: Error return value is not checked (errcheck)
  	case <-urgentReady:
  	     ^
  1 issues:
  * errcheck: 1
  
  Error: issues found
  Ran golangci-lint in 366904ms
  ```

Fixed in the new commit: `urgent_manager_test.go` now reads the value from `urgentReady` and reports it in the failure message (`case err := <-urgentReady: t.Fatalf(...)`), which is what main already has. `golangci-lint` 2.9.0 reports no issues for `./builder/workhub/...`. The file was only stale on this branch; nothing else in the PR changed.
